title: Makefile Generator
description: Build a Makefile from variables, targets and commands — real tab indentation included.
howto: Define targets: a "name: deps" line followed by command lines.
Copy the Makefile or download it.

faqs.a: A line "target: dep1 dep2", then one indented (or "> ") command line per command.
Make requires recipe lines to start with a tab — the generator emits actual tab characters.
Marks targets that are not files so make always runs them.
Save as "Makefile" (no extension) in your project root.
